preprocess_image_for_training: preprocess raw image bytes with random or center crop, resize, and optional horizontal flip for model training
get_random_crop_window: compute a random crop window with varied area and aspect ratio for data augmentation on image bytes
get_center_crop_window: compute a center crop window with padding for standardized image preprocessing at a given output size
clip_or_pad_tensor: clip or pad a TensorFlow tensor to a fixed size along its first dimension with a constant fill value
decode_and_crop_nonjpeg: decode non-JPEG image bytes and crop to a bounding box using a specified crop window
